fact: Ministerial order n°cab/min/pt&n/akim/kl/kbs/051/2024 of 17 August 2024 provisionally transferred the prerogatives of the Autorité de Protection des Données to the ARPTIC instead of the APD being created by Prime Minister's decree under Article 262.
title: ARPTIC/ARPTC investie des missions de l'Autorité de Protection des Données en RD Congo
